title: Finland Heads Toward Election Season With a Weakened Government and a… · 31 Aug
keywords: Finland, Orpo government, Finnish election, SDP, National Coalition Party, inflation, GDP growth, eurozone, fiscal policy, political legitimacy, EU politics, Nordic economies, austerity, cost of living
notes: Finland's ruling coalition is facing a mounting legitimacy crisis as opposition parties widen their polling lead ahead of the next election cycle. At the same time, the economy is growing again, but only modestly, and many households say they have yet to feel meaningful relief from years of elevated prices. Together, the political and economic strains are shaping a public mood that analysts describe as frustrated and increasingly impatient with the status quo.
